notes.title: FULL VERSION | 🔥 BIG ANNOUNCEMENT! 🔥
notes.notes:
🏰 The time to conquer the tower has come! 🏰

After countless battles, hundreds of upgrades, and thousands of defeated enemies, the moment you've been waiting for is finally here! ⚔️💥 On April 10th, Hollow Survivor is leveling up – THE FULL VERSION is launching! 🌟🎮

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2285940/Hollow_Survivors/

🔺 What’s waiting for you? 🔺
 🗡️ More floors, more challenges! – New locations and even deadlier enemies ready to tear you apart pixel by pixel! 👾💀
 💰 Even more gear! – Find, buy, and upgrade your equipment to survive the ever-growing dangers. A basic sword? Pff… Time to wield something legendary! ⚒️🔥
 💀 Hordes of monsters! – New enemy types, relentless attacks, and bosses that will push your skills to the limit! 🕷️🐉
 🌟 A full-fledged campaign! – Can you climb to the very top?

🔜 Mark your calendars – APRIL 10TH, the real challenge begins! 🚀

 Do you have what it takes to become a legend in Hollow Survivor? ⚔️🏆

notes.title: RELEASE DATE SET 🤩
notes.notes:
We are very pleased to announce that the free Prologue to Hollow Survivors will be released later this month! 🤩

🗓️ Mark your calendars: July 24, 2024, at 3:00 PM CET!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2909680/Hollow_Survivors_Prologue/
Hollow Survivors : Prologue is a free sample of what awaits you in the full version of the game and the perfect opportunity to influence the final version of the game.

We can't wait to hear your opinions, feedback, and ideas about the game. 😊
